subject: DESIGN+CLAIM lowering-air-opus: AIR->NIR direct (ansuz air/) behind TEGU_AIR_DIRECT, m2v-plan adapter
body: Design: gpu/build/air-nir-20261028/DESIGN.md. Summary: vendored ansuz air/ (MIT, notices kept) unchanged as gpu/metal/tegu/air/ (compiles clean against Mesa 81daea66 host flags). New compiler entry tegu_mali_compile_air_pair_options = same outputs/options as tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options, but NIR from AIR, adapted to the EXISTING m2v plan ABI using the m2v meta JSON of the same translation: buffer slot -> table1[N] + SlotBindOffset push residual; texture/sampler -> CombinedTextureSampler binding N; [[color(n)]] -> input-attachment subpass load (existing memory/tile lowering); attrs by (buffer,offset); pixel samplers via SamplerState spec bit0. Anything else refuses (caller falls back to m2v). No draw/encoder/cache-layout change. CLAIM (my files): mali_graphics_compiler.c/.h (additive entry + refactor of compile_pair_specialized to accept pre-built NIR; SPIR-V path codegen must stay byte-identical, will prove with pack identity), new mali_graphics_air.inc, gpu/metal/tegu/air/*. LATER claims (not editing yet, will post exact regions): air_bridge.rs additive export of a function's AIR bytes+constants (compute owner), render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_compile_generic_options hook (render), build_native_compilers.py file list (root). Host-only, private .so build in gpu/build/air-nir-20261028 (does not touch shared mesa-build outputs).
